timeline.text_en: Detonation bonus damage reduced to 25 (Down from 50).
Ravenous Vortex bonus damage reduced to 15% (Down from 30%).

timeline.text_cn: 冷却时间从16秒缩短至13秒。
持续时间从4秒缩短至3秒。
冷却时间从1秒缩短至0.5秒。
屏障现在会无限期持续。
可以通过再次按下辅助攻击模式取消。取消会让“虚空屏障”进入冷却。
现在会在初次部署时对敌人造成限制。
每秒伤害从35点降低至20点。
现在拥有100%生命汲取效果。

timeline.text_en: Can be recalled by pressing secondary fire again. Recall places Void Barrier on cooldown.
Now hinders enemies upon initial deployment.
Damage per second reduced from 35 to 20.

timeline.text_cn: 铁血形态——次级威能 持续时间延长从1秒增加至2秒。 “诛”持续期间效果减半。
持续时间延长从1秒增加至2秒。
纳米修复——主要威能 治疗量从75提高至100。
智械中枢强化体——稀有武器英雄物品
纳米愈疗器——史诗生存英雄物品
飞旋结界——史诗技能英雄物品
提高跳跃高度的效果现在仅对你自己生效，对盟友不生效。

timeline.text_en: Relentless Form – Minor Perk Duration bonus increased from 1 to 2 seconds. Half effectiveness during Annihilation.
Duration bonus increased from 1 to 2 seconds.
Nanite Repair – Major Perk Healing increased from 75 to 100.
Omnium Augment - Rare Hero Weapon Item
Swirling Ward - Epic Hero Ability Item
Increased Jump Height now only affects you and not your allies.

timeline.text_cn: 现在“天罚形态”激活时，冷却时间可见。

timeline.text_en: Cooldown is now visible while Nemesis Form is active.
Healing decreased from 50% to 25% of damage mitigated.
[Nemesis Form] Cooldown Reduction per enemy hit by [Ravenous Vortex] reduced from 1s to 0.5s.
Void Blight damage increased from 20 to 30.
[Ravenous Vortex] cooldown reduction reduced from 100% to 75%.
Final Form healing reduced from 80 to 50.

timeline.text_cn: “复仇旋涡”从威能改为基础技能。
现在能量球击中地面会直接爆炸。
能量球在空中也可以手动引爆。
“虚空屏障”的持续时间延长25%，尺寸增大25%。
从次级威能改为了主要威能。
连射间隔从0.75秒缩短至0.6秒。
已加入角斗领域英雄阵容。
“虚空加速器”会用纳米机器人感染敌人，对敌人造成100点伤害后会将其引爆，造成20点（武器强度）伤害。
“虚空加速器”持续射击时，周期性额外发射一簇包含6枚粒子的连射。
“虚空屏障”获得一次额外充能。
+25%“虚空屏障”尺寸。“虚空加速器”子弹和“猛拳”在穿过“虚空屏障”后，伤害提高10%。
“天罚形态”激活时，若拉玛刹处于“吞噬漩涡”中，每秒获得80点治疗。
“天罚形态”激活时，“吞噬漩涡”的冷却时间缩短100%。
在“天罚形态”下格挡时，使用“猛拳”可打出疾冲重拳。（4秒冷却时间）
“铁臂”会在3秒内治疗拉玛刹，数值为抵挡伤害量的50%。
解除“铁臂”时，对6米内的敌人造成伤害，数值为抵挡伤害量的100%，最多100点。
+50%“吞噬漩涡”半径，+30%“吞噬漩涡”伤害。
“吞噬漩涡”引爆时，造成50点伤害，且每命中一名敌人，获得2%终极技能充能。
聚变核心——稀有武器英雄物品
“铁臂”抵挡伤害时，攻击速度加快15%，持续3秒。
融合弹药——稀有武器英雄物品
智械中枢强化体——稀有武器英雄物品
R-7000电池——史诗武器英雄物品
“虚空加速器”持续开火时，在3秒内获得最多20%武器强度。
阿努比斯灵气——史诗武器英雄物品
“猛拳”伤害同时受技能强度加成。
贪念涡流——稀有技能英雄物品
“吞噬漩涡”每命中一名敌人，“天罚形态”的冷却时间缩短1秒。
归零矢量——稀有技能英雄物品
渊域拓展器——史诗技能英雄物品
飞旋结界——史诗技能英雄物品
盟友位于“吞噬漩涡”内时，其跳跃高度提高300%，移动速度加快25%。
终极轴心——史诗技能英雄物品
激活“诛”会拖拽6米内的敌人。
香巴里防护——稀有生存英雄物品
使用“铁臂”时获得的治疗量提高5%。
移除“铁臂”的移动速度惩罚。
禅雅塔的灵光——稀有生存英雄物品
退出“天罚形态”后，获得100点过量生命值。
巨型构装体——稀有生存英雄物品
“诛”造成伤害时获得过量生命值，数值为伤害量的20%。
纳米愈疗器——史诗生存英雄物品
“虚空屏障”在出生时会治疗6米内的盟友100点生命值。
腐蚀性外骨骼装甲——史诗生存英雄物品

timeline.text_en: Vengeful Vortex moved from Perk to Baseline ability.
Projectile now explodes on contact with the ground.
Explosion can now be manually detonated while airborne.
Void Barrier duration and size increased by 25%.
Moved from Minor to Major Perk.
Delay between bursts reduced from 0.75 to 0.6 seconds.
[Void Accelerator] infects enemies with nanites which explode for 20(WP) damage after dealing 100 damage.
[Void Accelerator] periodically releases a burst of 6 additional projectiles during continuous fire.
+25% [Void Barrier] size. [Void Accelerator] projectile and [Pummel] that passes through the [Void Barrier] gain 10% increased damage.
While [Nemesis Form] is active, Ramattra is healed for 80 per second while within [Ravenous Vortex].
When [Nemesis Form] is activated, reduce the cooldown of [Ravenous Vortex] by 100%.
While blocking in [Nemesis Form], use [Pummel] to perform a dashing punch. (4s Cooldown)
[Block] heals Ramattra for 50% of damage mitigated over 3s.
Releasing [Block] deals damage equal to 100% of the amount mitigated, up to 100 to enemies within 6m.
When [Ravenous Vortex] is detonated, deal 50 damage and gain 2% Ultimate Charge per enemy hit.
Fusion Core - Rare Weapon Hero Item
When [Block] mititgates damage, gain 15% Attack Speed for 3s.
Merged Munitions - Rare Weapon Hero Item
Omnium Augment - Rare Weapon Hero Item
R-7000 Powercell - Epic Weapon Hero Item
While continuously shooting [Void Accelerator], gain up to 20% Weapon Power over 3s.
Anima of Anubis - Epic Weapon Hero Item
[Pummel] damage is also increased by Ability Power.
Voracious Maelstrom - Rare Ability Hero Item
For each enemy hit by [Ravenous Vortex], reduce [Nemesis Form]'s cooldown by 1s.
Null Vector - Rare Ability Hero Item
Abyssal Extender - Epic Ability Hero Item
Swirling Ward - Epic Ability Hero Item
All allies within [Ravenous Vortex] gain 300% increased jump height and 25% increased Movement Speed.
Ultimatum Axis - Epic Ability Hero Item
Shambali Shielding - Rare Survival Hero Item
Zenyatta's Aura - Rare Survival Hero Item
Gain 100 Overhealth after coming out of [Nemesis Form].
Colossal Construct - Rare Survival Hero Item
[Void Barrier] heals allies within 6m by 100 on spawn.
Caustic Exo-Armor - Epic Survival Hero Item
Ravenous Vortex now heals Ramattra for 250% of the damage dealt (bypassing anti-heal).
Annihilation now heals Ramattra for 100% of the damage dealt (bypassing anti-heal).

timeline.text_cn: 吞噬漩涡可治疗拉玛刹，治疗量为其伤害量的250%（不受禁疗限制）。
“诛”可治疗拉玛刹，治疗量为其伤害量的100%（不受禁疗限制）。

timeline.text_en: Damage per second increased from 30 to 35.
No longer has half effectiveness while in Annihilation

lines_cn: 天罚形态激活时，造成消灭会使其持续时间延长1秒，“诛”持续期间该效果减半。

timeline.text_cn: 在第一次影响一个目标时，不再会短暂打断水平推进。天罚形态
铁臂（天罚形态）——辅助攻击技能
“铁臂”现在会触发1秒的冷却时间。

lines_en: While Nemesis Form is active, eliminations extend the duration by 1 second, half that during Annihilation.

timeline.text_en: No longer interrupts horizontal momentum when first affecting a target. Nemesis Form
Block ability now triggers a 1-second cooldown.

lines_en: Healing per second increased from 50 to 75.

timeline.text_en: Now reverses the gravity of all enemies inside.

timeline.text_cn: 现在会逆转位于其中的所有敌人的重力。
使虚空屏障的尺寸额外增加25%。

timeline.text_en: Void Accelerator periodically releases a burst of 6 additional projectiles during continuous fire.
Void Barrier's duration is increased by 25%.
Ramattra is healed for 50 health per second while within Ravenous Vortex.
While Ravenous Vortex is airborne, use Secondary Fire again to detonate it, dealing 50 damage and pulling enemies downward.
Now briefly interrupts horizontal momentum when first affecting a target.
Slowing field now ignores barriers for line of sight.
No longer deals critical damage to barriers.
Now deals 2.5x more damage to barriers.
Moved from his Ultimate to Ability 1
No longer pauses its duration while dealing damage.
Damage Per Second Decreased from 30 to 20.
Moved from his Ability 1 to his Ultimate.
Always has Annihilation active while in use.
Pummel Range has been increased from 10 to 15.
Projectile size increased from 0.075 to 0.1 meters.
Void Barrier Confirmation Input - Secondary Fire Release by default.
Void Barrier UI – On by default.
Block now reduces damage from stuck projectiles.
Block now reduces damage from stuck projectiles.
The projectile now passes through enemy heroes but is still blocked by barriers.
Block now respects holding the input through being stunned. Added the Hero-Specific Options:
Hide Nemesis Form Cancel Text - Off by default
Relative Aim Sensitivity During Nemesis Form - 100% by default
Relative Gyro Aim Sensitivity During Nemesis Form - 100% by default (only available on gyro-supported platforms)
Annihilation Cancel Input - Ability 1 by default
Using Annihilation while in Nemesis Form refreshes your bonus armor
Damaging enemies with the ultimate now slows the duration timer down instead of pausing it entirely. Lasts up to 20 seconds
Base health in Role Queue modes remains the same at 450
Base health in non-Role Queue modes reduced from 450 to 300
Primary: Fire a stream of projectiles in a fixed pattern
Secondary: Create a barrier at the targeted location
Transform into Nemesis Form, changing your attacks and gaining bonus armor
Primary: Punch forward, creating a wave of piercing energy with every swing
Secondary: Significantly reduces damage taken from the front and reduces movement speed
Fire a nano ball, which explodes when it hits the ground, spreading a damaging field. Affected enemies are slowed and pulled downward
Enter Nemesis Form and create an energy swarm surrounding yourself. This swarm will lash out towards nearby enemies, dealing damage and pausing the duration when damage is dealt.
Ramattra has been added to the line-up
